value.hook: read before editing the community route, templates, or running a fresh-seat canary
value.title: plan 204 community route and canary rig

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Plan 204 (s10, #136), merged 8e19abc. What to reuse:
- Printed commands in skills and templates: single-quote every placeholder; crates/cli/tests/skill_verb_coverage.rs checks exact flags per leaf, Usage-block required flags and quoting. Run it after any route or template edit.
- A shipped template version is never edited: add v<n+1> plus a SHIPPED row and a pinned sha256 in a_shipped_version_is_never_edited.
- Fresh-seat canary rig: docs/plans/204-community-route/assets/evidence/canary-rig.sh (private daemon, private tmux, scratch project). The rig must pin PIJ_RS_ADDR/PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR in its pij wrapper and clear the driver's PIJ_SPAWN_ID and COPILOT_LOADER_PID/COPILOT_CLI* or a Copilot canary refuses native registration. Copilot seats self-register there; OMP too.
- Verdict rounds: bobcat checks the test's own instrument (substring vs exact match); security wants literal shell words in any printed recipe.
